sources.note: Footnote pp. 513-514 gives stress for other Sepik Hill languages only: 'Lewis and Lewis (1970) indicate that stress occurs on the first syllable of the word in Sanio-Hiowe. Stress typically occurs on the penultima in Sumariup and Alamblak.. Dye and Dye (1969) give evidence for phonemic tone-stress in Bahinemo.' Bisis appears only in cognate-percentage discussion (p. 483) and three phonetic forms in Table 137 ([tuʔu-s] 'head', [ʔato] 'path', [f'oʔo] 'pig'); no statement about Bisis stress.
